name: Lumen Adaptive Climate Sneaker
description:
Lumen's signature sneaker reads ambient temperature, humidity, and UV index through sensors in the outsole and adjusts the upper's thermal properties in real time — breathable in heat, insulating in cold, water-shedding in rain. The upper is a woven aerogel composite that shifts from soft white to pale silver depending on light conditions. Low-profile, clean silhouette. Looks like a high-end fashion sneaker at a glance.

The shoe of choice for Tier 4 professionals who travel between climate zones daily and refuse to look disheveled doing it.
functionality: Real-time thermal and moisture regulation. Photochromic upper responds to UV. BCI-optional pairing for manual override.
what_it_says: You are always comfortable, always put-together, and you spent money to make that effortless.
story_hooks: A Lumen sneaker's climate sensor logged environmental data during a location its owner claims they never visited — the timestamp is damning.
A counterfeit Lumen has been circulating on the Shelf. It looks identical. The climate adaptation works. Nobody knows who made it.
